name: csvRead
description: Reads a CSV file and returns it in the requested format, such as a query, an array of structs or arrays, or a CSV string.

params.name: filePath
params.description: Path of the CSV file to read.

params.name: csvFormatConfiguration
params.description: Struct of parsing options. Keys include delimiter, quoteCharacter, escapeCharacter, encoding, header, skipHeaderRecord, ignoreEmptyLines, ignoreHeaderCase, allowMissingColumnNames, duplicateHeaderMode, commentMarker, nullString, trim and trailingDelimiter.

params.name: rowFilter
params.description: Function that receives the row array and row number, and returns true to include the row.
